children: Vodafone Group Public Limited Company Sponsored ADR (LSE:VOD) jumped to a 52-week high after a Goldman Sachs upgrade, as the company pursues EU IRIS² satellite spectrum talks with major carriers and launches Africa Data Centers Egypt with partners, aiming for up to $1B investment and significant job creation.
Vodafone Group Public Limited Company Sponsored ADR 52-Week High
: Vodafone ADR (VOD) hit a 52-week high of $17.14 after Goldman Sachs upgraded the stock to Buy, citing faster ROIC and expected UK market recovery boosting growth from 2027.
Vodafone To Bid For IRIS² Spectrum
: Vodafone (VOD) in early talks with Deutsche Telekom, Orange and Telefónica to join a consortium to bid for 2 GHz of EU IRIS² satellite spectrum to offer direct-to-mobile services in Europe.
Vodafone Partners For Africa Data Centers Egypt
: Vodafone (VOD) partners with Elsewedy and Cassava to launch Africa Data Centers Egypt; project targets up to $1B investment, ~200 direct jobs, ~2,000 indirect jobs, first phase ~ $200M FDI.
